Oral exams were also interesting and new but it wasn't hard if you did the work and read the material he wouldn't go out of his way to give you a bad grade.

He's a great guy and professor! I'm in his 318 class and he's hilarious, kind, and makes lectures super engaging. Attendance is mandatory but you get 4 free absences. He drops the 2 lowest Canvas quiz grades, and exams are in-person open-ended discussions, not traditional tests. Overall an amazing, absolutely enjoyable class—take him if you can!!
